items.title: Percy Gabriel Interview, 1987-07-10
items.q: him and a brother-in-law of mine, Joel of mine

ctx.x: And I made a trip here, and him and a brother-in-law of mine, Joel of mine, said, well, Joe had a sister in Chicago, and he wanted to come and visit his sister anyway, because there wasn't much work around here. And I told Lee College, my brothers, he said, bring him here. And they wanted him to play solo piano at this place where Lee College was playing. Mm-hmm. And he just sat in, Lee told him that, look at him, I don't want you to hear one of my homeboys. Yeah. And Clarence got on the piano, man hiding right…
I don't remember Chicago that way. Yeah. And I don't remember many places. Yeah. Did you ever go to the Victory Club there?
